info.title: Leshan Spring Kotlin device API
info.description: Registered devices only. Device responses, including LwM2M failures, use HTTP 200; inspect response.success. Sleeping queue devices fail immediately without deferred commands. Kafka commands are not implemented.

200.description: Registrations
Registration

parameters.name: X-Command-Id
parameters.description: Correlation only; does not deduplicate commands.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Leshan content format name, e.g. TLV or SENML_CBOR.

200.description: LwM2M response or successful local cancellation

post.description: Requires kind=instance. id=-1 assigns an ID on the device; a provided instance ID must match the URL.
